vllm_findings: Native Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration supports vision and language LoRA, with hybrid recurrent cache and packed GDN/QKV projection mappings. Every exact496PEFT target still requires load/application proof.

GDN source includes fused causal-conv/recurrent/gated-norm CUDA decode requiring SM80+, BF16, K=V128 and noninterleaved layout. Actual public shape matches; actual built symbol/dispatch remains unproved. A100 GDN prefill uses Triton/FLA rather than Hopper/Blackwell-specific FlashInfer prefill.

Current adapter has992FP32 tensors/rank8/alpha16 across496language targets. Optimized vLLM LoRA shrink asserts FP16/BF16 inputs and weights. Normal auto dtype follows BF16 base; loading the same serialized artifact changes current FP32PEFT arithmetic.

Pinned official BNB plugin0.0.3 supports prequant4bit states and inflight NF4 with compress_statistics=True. Its config defaults FP4/no-double do not describe the actual inflight loader, which hardcodes NF4/double statistics. Application casts BF16.

For NF4 preservation, prefer exact locally exported HF quantized state with tensor/quant_state/skip-set verification over assuming inflight equivalence. Vision and packed GDN/QKV mappings require proof. Plugin uses bitsandbytes matmul_4bit per packed shard, so it does not automatically gain Marlin linear kernels.

BF16 uses original public weights instead of the NF4 base used for training. Approximately55.586GB files imply51.8GiB weight storage; bounded12K cache and vision workspace may fit A10080GB but peak fitting remains unmeasured.

AWQ/GPTQ/Marlin conversions, merged/requantized adapters, and BF16 dequantization change math. FP8W8A8 is not an Ampere-native fast path in the official hardware table. None is current NF4 equivalence.
